lines.text: Some imagine him to be distant and disengaged.
Others make him a sentimental God who simply mirrors their desires.
Some imagine a God who only punishes and holds accountable.
Others make him out to be a God who only agrees with them.
But he is Allah, infinitely supreme, intimately near,
A Lord who wrote mercy before wrath, who listens before he even speak,
who was never far to begin with.
he has unveiled his essence through the names that shape our lives.
Names by which you can know him and call upon him.

verse.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَـٰٓئِهِۦ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verse.translation: And to Allāh belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.

lines.text: 99 doors that open to mercy and justice,
And no matter where you are right now,
somewhere in these 99 doors is the name you need.
